. While on shift, ensure that all employees are following policy and procedures. Ensures employee scheduling to given labor shell, and records time and attendance alterations to the guidelines of the Attendance Policy. Utilizing pars and order history, maintains adequate stock levels of products and supplies and merchandises them as accordingly. Provides and coaches friendly and efficient customer service. Provide coverage to staffing of any position per operational need. Communicates the needs of employees and customers to management. Required to maintain an acceptable attendance record, be punctual, and meet deadlines. Position will utilize University vehicles to oversee various Retail locations across campus and to respond urgently as needed.
Food and Workplace Safety.

Maintain the temperature logs for hot and cold held items. Ensure all surfaces are cleaned and sanitized. Inspecting of perishable products for quality, identify problems, and report to management. Ensure student employees are following safety and hygiene guidelines. Maintain the waste log. Keep preparation, storage, and service areas clean/debris free; proactively identify & correct hazards and issues.

Lead and direct a team of student employees while on shift. Utilizes and maintains the student employee training program. Assist in assigning specific jobs for student staff as to keep them on task and to meet goals and deadlines. Utilize and maintains the Opening and Closing Checklists and ensures staff is following guidelines. Receive & review incoming shipments and confirm quality of product entering facility, as well as accurate product delivery and invoicing. Delegates and assigns a wide range of tasks to student employees. Works to ensure prevention of injuries within the operation.
3 years of relevant experience (required)
Experience leading teams.
Must be able to work the hours of a 40-hour work week with the possibility of working weekends and evenings.
Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse group of people.
Ability to read, write, and follow oral and written instructions in English.
Ability to accurately handle money.
Ability to handle checks and complete credit card transactions.
Experience food preparation and general maintenance of a kitchen or dining area.
Ability to perform basic mathematical equations.
Legible handwriting and proficiency with computers.
Higher education food service experience (preferred).
Prior cashiering experience (preferred).
Prior merchandising experience (preferred).
Cafe experience/Barista experience (preferred)
Must be Servsafe certified within 90 days of employment (required).
Background check required.
